title: Haulage & dispatch monitoring
alerts_panel: Fires as 'Truck idling {idleTime} min' (warn, amber lamp) and 'Over-speed {speed} km/h' (critical, red lamp); tagged 'Haulage'. Both observed firing in headless verification (HT-01 idle warn, HT-03 over-speed critical).
caveats: Over-speed can also fire from random drift on any truck (speed schema 0-60) — intended realism.

title: HEMM predictive maintenance
alerts_panel: Fires as 'HEMM engine fault risk, RUL {rulHours} h' — message interpolates the live mock RUL value (observed: 'RUL 264 h'); tagged 'HEMM PdM'.
caveats: faultCode is freq:'manual' so it never drifts — the fault-code rule only fires if a code is staged by hand; the demo relies on the engineHealth trend instead.

title: OTR tyre / TPMS
alerts_panel: Fires as 'Tyre over-temp {tyreTemp} degC' (critical) and under/over-inflation warns; tagged 'TPMS'. Observed firing and driving HT-03's lamp red in verification.
caveats: One aggregate tyre pressure/temp per truck, not six wheel positions.

title: Vibration CBM (fixed plant)
params_added: vibrationRms + bearingTemp (screen, CHPP); crusher vibration/bearingTemp and pump vibration pre-existing
scripted_demo_asset: crusher-1 (vibration sweeps 2.5-12.5 mm/s, 170 s loop — passes through ISO zone C 'between' band into zone D critical)
alerts_panel: Fires as 'Vibration {v} mm/s in ISO zone C' (warn) then 'Bearing/imbalance fault' (critical); tagged 'Vibration CBM'. Both zone transitions observed in one sweep.
caveats: Conveyor CV-01 (catalog ConveyorBelt) has no vibration parameter in its catalog schema, so conveyor drives are not covered — adding one would change the global catalog type.

title: CHP specific energy (SEC)
alerts_panel: Fires as 'High specific energy {kwhPerTonne} kWh/t - check idle-running'; tagged 'CHP SEC'. Observed firing and driving screen-1's lamp amber.
caveats: Baselines are fixed per-asset thresholds, not computed from a rolling production baseline; conveyors excluded (same catalog-schema caveat as UC4).

title: Dust & environmental compliance
params_added: suppressionActive (new pm_monitor component, 7 parts, in new 'Environmental Monitoring' group with avg-PM10/noise KPIs)
alerts_panel: Fires as 'PM10 {pm10} ug/m3 above 150 action level' (warn) then 'Dust exceedance - PM10 {pm10} ug/m3 (suppression: {suppressionActive})' (critical) — the suppression indicator is interpolated into the message (pm-1 shows 1 = active); tagged 'Dust & Env'.
caveats: suppressionActive is a manual 0/1 mock flag surfaced in the message and tooltip, not a separate visual effect.
